name: Hometown
storyline:
In Hometown, players begin their journey with a small settlement and work toward building a thriving community. Through city planning, construction, and resource management, they develop neighbourhoods, establish homes and businesses, create public spaces, and expand their growing town.

As the town develops, players unlock new buildings, complete tasks, explore different areas, and discover elements inspired by real-world cultures and places. Each stage of development offers new opportunities to shape the settlement and create a community of their own.

Beyond building and managing a town, Hometown brings together themes of family, community, and cultural discovery. The experience encourages creativity and exploration while giving players the freedom to develop their virtual hometown at their own pace.
summary:
Hometown is a city-building simulation game that combines creativity, exploration, and family-oriented experiences. Players begin with a small settlement and gradually develop it into a thriving community by constructing homes, businesses, parks, and other important facilities.

The game allows players to plan neighborhoods, manage resources, complete tasks, unlock new buildings, and expand their towns. As the settlement grows, players can explore new areas, discover cultural landmarks, meet characters, and experience stories inspired by real-world places and traditions.
